accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury must sign — in governance context, a proposal must pass
and the governance program CPIs with the treasury PDA as signer.
Receives vault rent back.

accounts.name: treasury_input_ata
docs: Treasury's token account to receive escrowed tokens back.
For native SOL input this is unused — pass any account (e.g. treasury).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can crank this — permissionless cleanup.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can crank this — permissionless cleanup.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury — signer that funds the intent and is stored on the Intent
account for returning tokens later. In a governance context, the
native treasury PDA signs via CPI when a proposal executes this
instruction. Must be mut for native SOL transfers.

accounts.name: source_token_account
docs: Source token account holding input tokens. Must be owned by treasury.
For native SOL input this account is unused — pass any account (e.g. treasury).

accounts.name: output_mint
docs: Validated as a real mint so the intent can't store garbage.

accounts.name: executor
docs: Executor is permissionless — anyone can crank.
Pays for ATA creation if needed. Receives tip if tip_bps > 0.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault holding the escrowed input tokens (ATA of vault_authority).

accounts.name: output_vault
docs: Program-controlled output vault (ATA of vault_authority for output mint).
Swap routes ALL output here; the program then distributes treasury share and executor tip.

accounts.name: treasury_output_ata
docs: Treasury's token account for the output mint.
Created if it doesn't exist (executor pays ATA rent).

accounts.name: executor_output_ata
docs: Executor's token account for the output mint (receives tip).
Created if it doesn't exist. If tip_bps is 0 the swap just won't route here.

accounts.name: treasury_input_ata
docs: Treasury's token account for the input mint. Receives remaining dust after swap.
For native SOL input this is unused — pass any account (e.g. treasury).

accounts.name: governance
docs: ["native-treasury", governance] PDA == intent.treasury.

accounts.name: sowellian_config
docs: ["sowellian-config", governance.realm] PDA matches.

accounts.name: api_authority
docs: Off-chain risk-API co-signer. Required when the realm's
`SowellianConfig.api_authority` is non-default; ignored otherwise.

accounts.name: forward_intent
docs: The paired forward intent (USDC→asset). Owned by this program; key must
equal `intent.forward_intent_id`

accounts.name: bet
docs: validated by raw-offset read in the handler.

accounts.name: caller_usdc_ata
docs: mint == USDC and owner == bet.creator, validated manually in the handler.

accounts.name: slot_phyusd_ata
docs: The slot authority's PhyUSD ATA (Ember output → DepositFunds source)/

accounts.name: slot_usdc_ata
docs: Slot authority's USDC ATA

accounts.name: slot_phyusd_ata
docs: Slot authority's PhyUSD ATA
